observations: Native live Prey stands near the north canyon wall; its live Small Leech pursues the player.
Native death/landed captures show three independent death children in addition to the already existing live child. During launch the children can visually overlap; after landing they separate.
WASM death capture shows the three airborne bodies near the top of the view and their separated ground shadows; the airborne height is visible without a new render style.

River captures show a Small Leech at the player bank after crossing. The screenshot alone does not prove traversed distance; native swept-water tests and browser telemetry provide the movement evidence.
Natural Prey capture includes the production room residents and scenery. Ordinary crowd overlap and distant silhouettes still need broader readability review.
